concerns.text: Consumer‑before‑producer: unit test T009 (and T010, T011) are scheduled before the implementation task T012 that they test. The test tasks consume `code/generate_networks.py`, which does not exist yet.
Consumer‑before‑producer: unit tests T017 and T018 are placed before the HK simulation engine implementation T019 that they validate.
Consumer‑before‑producer: unit tests T026 and T027 precede the power‑law fitting and regression implementation tasks T028–T030, which they are meant to test.
Unsafe `[P]` tag: T004 writes to `data/checksums.json`. Later tasks T014 and T032 also write to the same file, so T004 is not parallel‑safe despite being marked `[P]`.

Unsafe `[P]` tag: T045 modifies `code/simulate_hk.py` (and adds `code/utils/performance.py`). Earlier tasks T019, T020, and T025 also modify `code/simulate_hk.py`, so T045 cannot safely run in parallel with them.
Unsafe `[P]` tag: T025 changes `code/simulate_hk.py` and adds `code/utils/monitor.py`, overlapping with other tasks that edit the same files (T019, T020, T045). Hence it is not parallel‑safe.

Mis‑placed user‑story tag: T016a is labeled `[US3]` but appears in the Phase 3 block that is otherwise dedicated to US 1. This breaks the requirement that each US block be an independently shippable unit and creates a cross‑story ordering ambiguity.
